item.name: Create WIP Entry
item._postman_note: Initializes/overwrites the full WIP snapshot for a project. Use 'Add Payment Entry' below for the 'Add payment entry' UI modal instead — this one is for initial setup only.

item.name: Add Payment Entry (WIP)
item._postman_note: CHANGED — payerName is no longer accepted from the client; it's auto-derived server-side from the project's real linked customer (payerCustomerId + payerName both set automatically) so the payer can't be an arbitrary typed string. A WIP entry must already exist for this leadId (create one via 'Create WIP Entry' first).

item.name: Expenses — Budget vs Actual Trend (chart)
item._postman_note: Monthly bar chart. See response 'note' field for the budget-definition assumption used — confirm it matches product intent.

item.name: Expenses — Import (CSV)
item._postman_note: csv is the raw CSV text (not a file upload). Required columns: category, date, amount. Optional: subcategory, description, projectId, buildingLabel, paymentMethod, status.

item.name: Add Expense
item._postman_note: department is new — Sales | Plant | Construction | Support. Used by Budget vs Actual's department filter / groupBy.

item.name: Profit & Loss Statement
item._postman_note: Also accepts projectId, startDate, endDate. Returns summary as an ordered array of rows (Project Revenue, Other Income, Total Income (A), Direct/Indirect/Admin/Other Costs, Total Expenses (B), Operating Profit (A-B), Tax Expense, Net Profit) each with thisPeriod/lastPeriod/variance, plus incomeVsExpenseTrend (daily). See response 'note' field for the expense-category-mapping caveat.

query.description: monthly | quarterly | yearly — resolves to the current calendar month/quarter/year. Ignored if startDate/endDate are also passed (those take precedence).

item.name: Profit & Loss — Export
item._postman_note: Also accepts projectId, startDate, endDate, period (monthly|quarterly|yearly) — same filters as the main P&L endpoint.

item.name: Margin Analysis
item._postman_note: projectId and startDate/endDate filters now actually applied to all three sections (overall margin %, marginTrend, projectMargins) — previously projectId was accepted but silently ignored and marginTrend always showed a fixed last-6-months window regardless of filters. Fixed 2026-08-11. Omit projectId/startDate/endDate for the unfiltered company-wide view.
